docs.title: The Time Ontology for ITS (bundle)
docs.text:
The The Time Ontology for ITS (bundle) consists of the following patterns:

  • Core
  • Fuzzy Time
  • Schedule

The formal definition of this ontology is available in TURTLE Syntax.

docs.title: CalendarWeekWithinMonth
docs.text:
Specification of recurring periods in terms of the calendar week(s) of the month.

NOTE: Different codes can potentially have different definitions on whether partial weeks are counted and the day of week on which a new week starts.

docs.title: FuzzyTime
docs.text:
An instant in time designated by a named timeReference event (e.g., dusk) coupled with a defined offset either before or after the referenced event. The timeReference can be any value from a recognized FuzzyTimeCode. The offset indicates the amount of units of time from this event either before or after the timeReference.

EXAMPLE: 30 minutes after dusk

docs.title: Time Ontology for ITS - Core module
docs.text:
This ontology defines core concepts related to time within Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS). This module is used to import the core concepts from the various Time Ontology for ITS patterns.

This pattern imports the following files:

  • https://w3id.org/itsdata/core/v1/

This pattern consists of the following classes:

  • Time Thing

The formal definition of this pattern is available in TURTLE Syntax.

docs.title: Time Ontology for ITS - Fuzzy Time Pattern
docs.text:
This ontology defines concepts related to fuzzy time within Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS). This pattern is one module of the Time Ontology for ITS.

This pattern imports the following files:

  • https://w3id.org/itsdata/time/v1/Core

This pattern consists of the following classes:

  • Clock Time
  • Fuzzy Time
  • Fuzzy Time Code
  • Time Of Day

The formal definition of this pattern is available in TURTLE Syntax in two files, the core semantics and the SHACL restrictions.

docs.title: Time Ontology for ITS - Schedule Pattern
docs.text:
This ontology defines concepts related to schedules for temporal validity in traffic and transport situations. This pattern is one module of the Time Ontology for ITS.

This pattern imports the following files:

  • https://w3id.org/itsdata/time/v1/FuzzyTimePattern

This pattern consists of the following classes:

  • Calendar Week Within Month
  • Date Within Month
  • Day Week Month
  • Instance Of Day Within Month
  • Overall Period
  • Period
  • Public Event Code
  • Public Holiday
  • Schedule
  • Schedule Thing
  • Special Day
  • Special Day Type Code
  • Time Period Of Day
  • Validity Status Code
  • Week Code

The formal definition of this pattern is available in TURTLE Syntax in two files, the core semantics and the SHACL restrictions.
